png_first_round_outlier.attribution: Main-thread drawing and concurrent GC coincide; this does not identify a production-code cause or a GC pause. No late frame overlaps actual PNG decode.

limitations: Three observations per condition, one emulator, sequential build batches; no statistical confidence or product SLO claim.
Automated injected input, seven 16 ms pacing intervals plus save polling; not real-pen latency.
PNG whole-operation overlap is 24/24, but real decode overlaps 1/24 inputs and only two decode calls cross each measured window.
All in-window GPU_DURATION values are negative platform data and are excluded. SurfaceFlinger FrameTimeline was omitted after a producer clock failure in smoke testing.
CPU percentages sum scheduled time divided by elapsed window; other threads can exceed 100% on multiple cores. Concurrent GC slice wall time is not stop-the-world pause duration.
Encryption includes cryptography, allocation and file I/O; aggregate worker CPU alone does not isolate a code hotspot.
Functional/trace PASS does not mean no performance regression. Preserve PNG round 1 and deadline misses as observed tail degradation.
